about_the_game:
The king has been abducted!

You, Wumball, must save him from the hideous monster!

Travel through various unique areas on your adventure to save the king!

It may seem simple enough, but be warned! It only takes one hit to kill you and you have no weapons to defend yourself! You'll meet hoards of monsters that will pose a significant threat to your physical and mental health!

- Features -

  • Lots of rooms! There are over 150 rooms to explore.

  • 2 alternate pathways! One route is the standard and recommended way to play the game. The other path is shorter, but it is nearly impossible (so don't expect to beat it).

  • NPCs! Interact with NPCs. Pretty standard game stuff.

  • Code system! If you've quit the game, you can input Continue Codes to return to different save rooms. Talk to the Savedogs in these rooms to find out your Continue Codes.

  • Potential Frustration!  This game may be challenging, but winning makes it all the more rewarding.

  • Creator's first game! This is the first video game that Isaac L. Swartz has made and published.

No weapons to defend yourself, no health to waste. Go and save the king and put that monster in its place!
